title: Aspiring writer-director here. I’ve got a question.

commenti.body:
Hello u/biiiiiii462874817472, you've seriously completely ruined this subreddit. It's disheartening to witness the decline in quality content and meaningful discussions that were once the hallmark of this community. Your actions have not only disrupted the atmosphere but have also driven away many dedicated members who used to contribute positively.  
  
Communities thrive on collaboration, respect, and a shared commitment to the core values that make them unique. Your disregard for these principles has created an environment that's toxic and unwelcoming. The once vibrant exchange of ideas has been replaced with chaos and frustration.  
  
It's important to remember that a subreddit is a collective space where individuals come together to share common interests, learn from one another, and engage in constructive conversations. Your disruptive behavior not only impacts the current state of the subreddit but also sets a precedent for future interactions.  
  
In order to salvage what remains of this community, it's crucial to reflect on the consequences of your actions and consider how you can contribute positively moving forward. Apologizing and making amends with the community could be a first step towards rebuilding trust and fostering a more positive atmosphere. Ultimately, the success of any online community relies on the collective efforts of its members to maintain a healthy and inclusive environment.
